subject: SIG: Evidence assembly & redaction guidance for Sunrise Capital RFP
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <security@sunrisecap.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sunrise Capital Procurement <procurement@sunrisecap.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG: Evidence we need for Sunrise Capital RFP

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking the time on the call last week. As discussed, we are moving to the final stage of our vendor review and need a clean set of evidentiary artifacts mapped to the SIG control statements. Our security team expects: 

- A completed control crosswalk (SIG -> SOC 2 / ISO mapping)
- Representative artifacts for high-risk controls (encryption key provenance, access logs, privilege reviews)
- Redaction guidance so legal can review before we ingest into our portal

Can you confirm you can provide the above by EOD Tue (Aug 31)? Also let us know the point of contact for any follow-up samples.

Attachments we expect: a crosswalk workbook, a sample access log (redacted), and any KMS/key-control proof artifacts. If any of this needs an NDA or special transfer channel, call that out.

Best,
Alex Morgan
Senior InfoSec Manager
Sunrise Capital

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <security@sunrisecap.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sunrise Capital Procurement <procurement@sunrisecap.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Evidence we need for Sunrise Capital RFP

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. Yes, we can deliver the crosswalk and the representative artifacts. Quick notes / asks so we align: 

1) Scope: We'll prepare a SIG -> SOC2/ISO 27001 control crosswalk and mark the evidence type per control (sample, template, or in-situ proof).
2) Redaction: We will provide a redaction guidance doc and fully redacted samples (PII/tenant ids removed). If Sunrise has any custom redaction rules beyond standard pseudonymization, please share.
3) Sensitive artifacts (KMS proof): we will provide a PDF export of the attestation and a signed KMS key rotation excerpt — if you prefer an encrypted transfer, we can use the secure SFTP we've used before or a DocuSign secure envelope.

Action items from our side: I will own the crosswalk and evidence bundle. Priyom will assemble telemetry/access-sample and produce a redacted log. Kimberly will owner the encryption/KMS artifacts and the redaction guidance file.

Can you confirm that the three items (crosswalk, redacted logs, KMS proof) meet the requirement and that we can deliver by COB Tue (Aug 31) ET?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <security@sunrisecap.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 08:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG: Evidence we need for Sunrise Capital RFP

On Mon, Aug 30, 2027 at 11:04 AM marcus_lin@redwood.com wrote:
> Alex —
> 
> Thanks for the clear list. Yes, we can deliver the crosswalk and the representative artifacts.

Hi Alex —

Quick update from the collection side: attached are three artifacts we intend to include in the bundle: 

- SIG_Control_Crosswalk_v1.xlsx (tabbed: SIG, SOC2-AICPA, ISO27001, EvidenceNotes)
- sample_access_log_redacted.txt (ips masked, user ids hashed, timestamps preserved)
- kms-proof-sample.pdf (redacted key ids, includes rotation timestamps and HSM vendor attestation excerpt)

I also uploaded a short redaction guide (redaction_guidelines.md) that documents our masking rules and what we strip vs retain for auditability.

Notes: 
- The access log retains relative timestamps and request ids for traceability; absolute PII removed.
- If you need original (unredacted) artifacts for internal auditing, we require a one-time SFTP token and a signed evidence transfer acknowledgment (we can provision this quickly).

Looping in Kimberly for the KMS attestation confirmation.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG_Control_Crosswalk_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample_access_log_redacted.txt (text), kms-proof-sample.pdf (pdf), redaction_guidelines.md (markdown)
From: Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <security@sunrisecap.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Evidence we need for Sunrise Capital RFP

Alex — thanks, quick confirmation from my side: 

- KMS proof: kms-proof-sample.pdf contains rotation logs, HSM vendor sign-off excerpt, and an exported key policy snapshot. Key IDs are masked; we include a mapping table in the crosswalk that indicates which masked ID maps to which control statement.
- Redaction: redaction_guidelines.md clarifies that tenant identifiers and client-specific tokens are replaced with stable hashes; timestamps are preserved to allow your team to correlate events without exposing PII.
- Transfer method: we are happy to send the final zip via SFTP and will provide a one-time token; if procurement prefers a DocuSign envelope for the transfer acknowledgment, send DocuSign link and we will sign.

I'll assemble a final ZIP named SUN-2027-042_SIG_Evidence_v1.zip and drop it on secure storage once Alex confirms the preferred transfer channel.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
